subject: Welcome to Club House OS
body: Hi Hackney Marshes FC, welcome aboard. This is where we'll send you updates, confirmations on requests you've made, and anything else worth flagging. You can always reach us directly via Tools → Contact Us.

subject: Your sponsorship application has been submitted
body: We've submitted your application for the request you logged on 28 July. We'll update you here as soon as we hear back.

subject: New perk available on your plan
body: A new partner perk just went live for Premium clubs. Take a look under Workspace → Perks.
